audit_scope: Read-only literature and saved-artifact audit; arithmetic checks only on saved validation workload loss sums. No fitting, fresh prediction, holdout evaluation, or protocol change.

spec.analysis: report every seed, candidates, rounds, both validation metrics, unweighted seed delta summaries; no independent-seed significance claim
spec.confirmatory_tests: untouched; no confirmatory test results in this study notebook
spec.failure_policy: stop on resource/data/protocol failure; keep partial checkpoints and all seed statuses; no seed replacement, no grid/data changes
spec.feature_processing: verbatim archived feature_columns, fit_encoding, encode; train only
spec.pilot_gate: all 24 candidates and both winners committed; sampled RSS <= 8 GiB; sampled available >= 2 GiB

population.eligible_selection: inner join original seed-20260927 train/validation to eligible IDs before returning any features/outcomes
population.feature_target_processing: copied original features and duration_hours; no re-cleaning, target transform applied at fit time
population.historical_ids_use: only exclusion membership and exclusion counts; not exported
population.label: new restricted-population robustness study; not direct full-population replication

spec.secondary_metric: equal-workload validation LogMAE, never used for selection
spec.seed_interpretation: 10 split seeds; one fixed model seed, as in experiment 2
spec.selection: minimum validation execution LogMAE; lowest candidate_id breaks ties
spec.study: new restricted-population robustness study; not full-population replication
spec.target: numpy.log1p(duration_hours), no clipping or inverse transform
spec.test_policy: historical holdouts excluded; new per-seed test outcomes never loaded or evaluated
